::: {.recipe-meta}
**Serves:** 8\
**Prep time:** 20 minutes\
**Cook time:** 1½ hours

[Main]{.badge .badge-main}
:::

*You actually don't have to be poor to make this.*

## Ingredients

- 2 lbs ground beef
- bread (chopped)
- 1 onion (diced)
- 1 can tomatoes
- 1 eggs
- garlic powder
- salt
- black pepper
- ketchup

## Instructions

*Preheat the oven to 350°F.*

1. Mix all the ingredients except for the ketchup together until homogeneous.
2. Top with the ketchup.
3. Bake for 1½ hours.
